يستخبرون (form X)
# يَسْتَخْبِرُونَ (yastaḵbirūna) /jas.tax.bi.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَخْبَرَ (istaḵbara)
# يُسْتَخْبَرُونَ (yustaḵbarūna) /jus.tax.ba.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَخْبَرَ (istaḵbara)
